keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Goal! Como 1, Cagliari 0. Jacobo Ramón (Como) header from very close range to the top left corner. Assisted by Yan Couto with a cross.
Delay in match because of an injury Jean Butez (Como).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
First Half ends, Como 1, Cagliari 0.
Substitution, Cagliari. M'Bala Nzola replaces Paul Mendy.
Second Half begins Como 1, Cagliari 0.
Delay in match because of an injury Michel Adopo (Cagliari).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Cagliari. Juan Rodríguez replaces Michel Adopo because of an injury.
Goal! Como 2, Cagliari 0. Lucas da Cunha (Como) header from the centre of the box to the high centre of the goal. Assisted by Yan Couto with a cross.
Substitution, Como. Máximo Perrone replaces Luis Milla.
Substitution, Como. Nico Paz replaces Mattia Liberali.
Delay in match because of an injury Daniel Maldini (Cagliari).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Cagliari. Yael Trepy replaces Nicola Grandu.
Delay in match (Como).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Como. Adrian Lahdo replaces Samuele Ricci.
Substitution, Como. Ivan Smolcic replaces Lucas da Cunha.
Substitution, Cagliari. Alieu Fadera replaces Daniel Maldini.
Substitution, Cagliari. Yanis Massolin replaces Alessandro Deiola.
Substitution, Como. Álex Valle replaces Martin Baturina.
Delay in match (Como).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
